content.text: Found an important bug (children ordering when TYPE3 uses direct children). Let me fix it:

arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'PY'
p='src/image.cpp'
s=open(p).read()
old = """    nodes_[self].children = refs;
    nodes_[self].subtree = subtree;"""
new = """    // Children are compared by key; direct and bulk records may appear in any
    // order inside a TYPE3 record, so normalise the child list here.
    std::sort(refs.begin(), refs.end(),
              [](const ChildRef& a, const ChildRef& b) { return a.key < b.key; });
    nodes_[self].children = refs;
    nodes_[self].subtree = subtree;"""
assert old in s
s = s.replace(old, new)
open(p,'w').write(s)
PY

s=open(p).read()
